state:
Goal `core-process-and-4-more`. `Core\Process` is green. `Core\Process\Handle` has its class card, and `kill`, `readStdout` and `readStderr` have all their feature proofs. `writeStdin` and `wait` still owe everything but their cards, and those cards are still in the old voice. `Core\Process\Result`, `Core\Program` and `Core\Queue` are untouched and still in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.

The two red floor checks from the last sweep are green. The `Core\Db\Connection::query` attack lost its `proof: gap` marker: carrying a blocking-pool answer onto the caller makes step 6 stop at the ceiling. The gap record `nvs-stdlib/buffered-read-is-not-held-to` stays open with narrower text: the host still peaks near a gigabyte under a 256M limit before the `FATAL`. The `card` impact probe now keeps `nvs:` checks, which is what commit `6f2519a6c` made them do.

A Unix-only example is run by hand under WSL. Put the commands in a script under `.agent-tmp/` and start it with `wsl.exe -- bash -lc "bash <script>"`. In the script, build with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl cargo build` from `/mnt/d/mwl`, run `/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl/debug/nvs run --config <dir>/nvs.toml <file>`, and write the `.out` with Write from what it printed. The attacks and benches run on both platforms: they pick `/bin/sh` / `/usr/bin/yes` or `cmd.exe` by `Core\Path::SEPARATOR`; a shell that runs an endless `yes` uses `exec`, so `kill` reaches it. `?bytes` narrows through `!= null` in a `while` or `if` head, not through `&&`. A perf figure goes stale whenever `process.rs` changes: `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Process\Handle'` re-measures it.

items.text: **`Core\Process\Handle::writeStdin`** — about, examples, attack, bench, and two tests carrying `// covers: Core\Process\Handle::writeStdin`: add it to `tests/conformance/core/process-spawn-streams-a-childs-output-into-the-program.nvst` (its `cat` round trip already calls it), and write a Rust test beside `a_spawned_childs_error_output_is_read_apart_from_its_output`. Rewrite `WRITE_STDIN_DOC` in the plain voice, the way `READ_STDERR_DOC` now reads. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/process.rs:407`

**`Core\Process\Handle::wait`** — the same; rewrite `HANDLE_WAIT_DOC`. `killing_a_spawned_child_ends_it_and_wait_answers_its_status` already calls it and can carry the marker. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/process.rs:427`

backlog: `Core\Process\Result`, `Core\Program`, `Core\Queue`: class cards and every member's proofs (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs` `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`).
A buffered `Core\Db` read peaks at its whole result before the ceiling is met — gap record `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/buffered-read-is-not-held-to.json`, owned by `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/mod.rs`.

A `FATAL` for the memory limit reports the balance after the statement's value is freed (`67820 bytes held against a ceiling of 268435456`), which reads as if nothing was over — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs`.
